recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If a work group wants OperationOutcome to disallow success in the future, handle that as a new substantive tracker because the current published source already reflects FHIR-39622 plus the AuditEvent outcome family.
issue_request: FHIR-39622 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested a success code in the issue-severity CodeSystem so AuditEvent.outcome would not need the legacy DICOM AuditMessage code 0. The resolution initially mentioned excluding success from the OperationOutcome value set, but the Jira implementation comment says the code was not excluded because OperationOutcome also needed it.
initial_application: Commit 8f211ebdacaf671e71325a20d4a0912cc4ff836b added the success concept to source/operationoutcome/codesystem-issue-severity.xml and added success to the OperationOutcome.issue.severity short display. Commit 37ac63c5f95ed32f999e577036595a9c1da1547d updated source/auditevent/valueset-audit-event-outcome.xml so AuditEvent outcome imports http://hl7.org/fhir/issue-severity instead of carrying the old DICOM 0 include.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists OperationOutcome and AuditEvent as active resources. Current source has success in issue-severity, OperationOutcome.issue.severity explicitly lists success and binds to ValueSet/issue-severity, and AuditEvent outcome includes the issue-severity system. FHIR-32445 is a related AuditEvent outcome terminology decision supporting the shared issue-severity approach once success exists; it is already represented on the combined branch. FHIR-27840 is earlier background on successful OperationOutcome responses, but FHIR-39622 and its implementation are the later accepted source state. Focused Zulip and Confluence searches found the FHIR-I vote minutes and no conflicting community decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Excluding success from OperationOutcome now would reverse the applied Jira comment and 2023 source commit rather than fixing a current-spec defect.

related_jiras.note: Published AuditEvent outcome terminology decision requiring AuditEvent outcome to import OperationOutcome issue-severity codes and anticipating that issue-severity would be sufficient once success existed.
Earlier OperationOutcome discussion about successful results and severity wording; later FHIR-39622 superseded the no-success direction by adding an explicit success code.
